svg.title: Business group-average p50 after message bursts
svg.desc: Every batch starts empty. Four burst sizes, all queues, identical horizontal scale. Mean of three runs of p50 of 16-call business group averages. Dashed line: normal business 13 ns/call.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(95%,96%,98%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Business performance immediately after a message batch
Every batch starts empty. Same scale in all panels. Lower is better. Dashed line: normal business (13 ns/call).
